entities.summary: Lesotho is a sovereign nation in Southern Africa, Africa. Its capital is Maseru. Official languages include Sesotho (Southern Sotho), English. Government: Unitary parliamentary constitutional monarchy. Population: approximately 2.3 million. Area: 30,355 km². Comprehensive index for Lesotho covering San rock art, Moshoeshoe I (nation builder), Basotho nation formation, Gun War, Basutoland protectorate, independence 1966, mountain kingdom (entirely above 1000m), Lesotho Highlands Water Project (LHWP), and political instability.
